learnings.label: DERIVED
learnings.finding: Every normalized real mixture of the scaled even/odd profiles retains exponentially large positive and negative genuine prime charges, uniformly even for aperture-dependent coefficients.
learnings.consequence: Pointwise positivity or small unsigned mass cannot replace control of the full signed difference. The same result does not prohibit cancellation of complete scalar energies.

learnings.finding: The K3 vectors have nonzero extra moments; the moment-zero quartic witness cannot be substituted into K3. The relevant even slice first becomes nonzero at K4; the odd M3/M5 slice at K5.
learnings.consequence: If using those extra moments, retain the larger actual carrier, its normalization and the exact witness. No ground/eigenvector or energy-sign conclusion follows merely from existence.

new_composition.title: The complete fixed-real mixture, not just its limiting profile, preserves every right-zero pole
new_composition.statement: Fix real a,b, not both zero, BEFORE L. Put T_ab(L)=a L^9 Q_e(L)+b L^7 Q_o(L). If an off-line zero exists and Theta is the actual supremum of positive shifted real parts, both signed logarithmic excursion rates of T_ab are Theta. Equivalently for each0<alpha<Theta,C>0,R0 there are separate L>=R0 with T_ab>C exp(alpha L) and T_ab<-C exp(alpha L).
new_composition.proof: Use the already reviewed COMPLETE all-zero formulas, not the limiting prime profile. Set C_o=240^2(2pi)^6, b0(p)=(1/4-p^2)^2/p^14 and r_p(L)=product_(n=1)^3(1+(2pi n/(pL))^2)^-2. Exactly T_ab=2C_o sum_ALL_p m_p b0(p)(36pi^2 a-b p^2)(exp(pL)-1)r_p(L). The constant -1 channel and multiplicities remain. At any actual right-zero p=delta+i gamma with delta>0 and gamma nonzero, Im(p^2)=2delta gamma is nonzero. If b is nonzero the real-coefficient factor cannot vanish; if b=0 then a is nonzero and it also cannot vanish. The high-zero majorant is a constant times |b0(p)|(1+|p|^2), which is summable. The same rational-aperture pole disk, vertical-ray continuation and locally normal high-zero tail from the fixedK3 proof therefore apply without any new moving coefficient or ratio poles. At the rightmost zero of one chosen finite height fiber the leading Laplace residue is2C_o m b0(p)(36pi^2 a-b p^2), nonzero. The same positive-tail Landau argument and strict exponent absorption yield each signed rate; the full coefficient sum gives the matching Theta upper envelope. No globally rightmost zero is needed.
new_composition.limits: This follow-through is DERIVED and not newly Lean-compiled. It applies to fixed real coefficients only. The attachment uniform unsigned statement also allows coefficients varying with L, but it does not justify a Landau transform for such varying coefficients. Nor does the fixed-mixture result give a signed bound: a freely chosen normalized coefficient pair may depend on the actual energies and cancel their scalar combination at each aperture. No full-state or arithmetic estimate follows from that choice.

current_signed_target.missing: An independent one-sided bound on the complete actual signed C_psi at the required scale. Eventual C_psi>=-J is a reviewed paper-level RH-equivalent target, not an available premise.
